text: セーブルック・タウンのキャラム・ヴァルガが69分、タリク・マーロウのスルーパスからゴールを決めて、2-2の同点に追いつきました。約9メートルの距離からのシュートで、成功確率が低めのチャンス（約6%）を見事にものにしました[#1448]。この攻撃は、アイデン・クインランのインターセプトから16秒以内に3回のパスでつながった速攻で、相手の組織が整う前に一気に仕掛けたプレーでした[#1442-1447]。ここ10分では、セーブルックが53％のボール保持で攻撃を優勢に進めています。

- Seabrook Town regained possession through an interception by Aiden Quinlan, initiating a quick transition counter-attack that exploited Harbour City’s brief moment of disorganization [#1442].
- The move featured a progressive long pass from Quinlan to Kian Adeyemi, who advanced into the final third, demonstrating Seabrook Town’s strategy to quickly switch play and use vertical ball progression despite their general wide crossing style, likely to catch Harbour City’s 4-2-3-1 formation off guard [#1443, #1444].
- The ball was then circulated through a short pass to Tariq Marlowe, who delivered a precise through ball assist to Callum Varga, reflecting an overload in the attacking zone to create a high-quality scoring opportunity from open play [#1445, #1446].
- This build-up sequence of only three passes over 16.1 seconds from turnover to goal reflects Seabrook Town’s ability to efficiently exploit their 3-4-3 formation’s wide players in combination with quick progressive moves, countering Harbour City’s patient short passing style and more methodical 4-2-3-1 setup [#1442-1448].

- Callum Varga scored a goal from open play with a shot from 9.0 meters, assisted by Tariq Marlowe through a through pass [#1448].
- The goal equalized the score, making it 2-2 after Seabrook Town were trailing 1-2 before the goal.
- The goal came after a 16.1 second buildup involving 3 passes starting from a regained possession via an interception by Aiden Quinlan [#1442].
- Seabrook Town had 52.8% possession and 4 shots in the last 10 minutes, showing increased offensive pressure.
- Harbour City had a lower pass accuracy of 80.3% and only 1 shot with no goals in the last 10 minutes, struggling offensively.
